description_en: Queries the currently active API Key and its invocation method for a specified service endpoint within a workspace
description_zh: 查询指定工作空间内服务端点当前生效的 API Key 及其调用方式
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-service-endpoint-api-key --workspace-id ws-1 --service-endpoint-id se-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetServiceEndpointApiKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the service endpoint belongs
parameters.help_zh: 服务端点所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the service endpoint for which to query the API Key
parameters.help_zh: 要查询 API Key 的服务端点 ID
parameters.name: service_endpoint_id

code.description_en: The response code. The value is SUCCESS when the request succeeds
code.description_zh: 响应代码。请求成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The currently active API Key information for the service endpoint
data.description_zh: 服务端点当前生效的 API Key 信息

apiKey.description_en: The currently active API Key for the service endpoint. The service reads this value from the gateway consumer in real time. AgentCore does not persist the plaintext. When calling the service endpoint, include this value in the request header specified by apiKeyName. Do not log this value or expose it in public configurations
apiKey.description_zh: 服务端点当前生效的 API Key。服务从网关消费者实时读取该值，AgentCore 不持久化该明文。调用服务端点时，将该值放入 apiKeyName 指定的请求头。请勿将该值记录到日志或公开配置中

apiKeyFingerprint.description_en: The API Key fingerprint, which consists of the first 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 digest of the API Key. It can be used to identify the key version but cannot replace the API Key for authentication
apiKeyFingerprint.description_zh: API Key 指纹，为 API Key 的 SHA-256 摘要前 12 位小写十六进制字符，可用于识别密钥版本，不能代替 API Key 进行鉴权

apiKeyName.description_en: The name of the HTTP request header used to pass the API Key. The value is currently fixed to x-api-key
apiKeyName.description_zh: 传递 API Key 的 HTTP 请求头名称。当前固定为 x-api-key

apiKeySource.description_en: The location where the API Key is passed. The value is currently fixed to Header, indicating that the API Key is passed through an HTTP request header
apiKeySource.description_zh: API Key 的传递位置。当前固定为 Header，表示通过 HTTP 请求头传递

authenticationType.description_en:
The authentication type of the service endpoint. Valid values:
NONE: Authentication is not enabled.
API_KEY: API Key authentication is used.

This operation succeeds only when the authentication type is API_KEY. Therefore, the value API_KEY is always returned in a successful response
authenticationType.description_zh: 服务端点的鉴权类型。枚举值：NONE（不启用鉴权）、API_KEY（使用 API Key 鉴权）。本接口仅在鉴权类型为 API_KEY 时调用成功，因此成功响应中固定返回 API_KEY

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the service endpoint belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 服务端点所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. The value is 200 when the request succeeds
httpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时为 200

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success when the request succeeds
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The request ID, used for troubleshooting and tracing
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和追踪本次请求

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. The value is true when the request succeeds
success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。请求成功时为 true
